title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Learning Agent introduces personalized upskilling notifications in Teams
summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot Learning Agent will deliver personalized upskilling notifications in Teams based on users' roles and usage. Rolling out from mid-November 2026, it helps users access relevant training within Teams, enhancing AI fluency and confidence. Admins can manage notifications via Viva Learning settings.
body:
[What and why]

Learning Agent will proactively deliver personalized AI and Copilot upskilling notifications through Microsoft Teams. Tailored to users' roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns, these notifications will help users discover relevant learning opportunities and develop practical skills they can apply in their daily work.

[Rollout schedule]

- Public Preview: We will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026 and expect to complete by late November 2026.- General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-December 2026 and expect to complete by mid-December 2026.

[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users who receive personalized Learning Agent notifications in Microsoft TeamsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft 365 Copilot- Microsoft Teams- Microsoft Viva LearningWhat will happen

After rollout:

- Personalized upskilling: Users will receive relevant learning notifications based on their roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns.- Learning in the flow of work: Users will be able to discover and access Learning Agent directly through Teams notifications, reducing the effort of finding training.- Improved AI fluency: Users will be guided toward practical, task-based learning experiences that help them develop Copilot skills.- Greater confidence: Users can progress from basic Copilot interactions to more advanced, productive usage.

Notifications will respect the existing Copilot Academy notification setting in Viva Learning. If this setting is disabled at the tenant level, users in the organization will not receive these notifications.

[Action required and recommendations]

No administrator action is required. This feature will roll out automatically.

Administrators can manage notifications using the existing Copilot Academy notification setting in Viva Learning.

To review or change this setting:

- Go to Viva Learning Admin > Notification Settings.- Review the Copilot Academy notification setting.- Clear the setting to disable notifications for users in your organization.

Learn more

- Microsoft Copilot Academy | Microsoft Learn

[Compliance considerations]

The feature uses users' roles, Copilot adoption stages, and usage patterns to personalize learning notifications.

Review this change as appropriate for your organization's compliance requirements.

No administrator action is required. This feature will roll out automatically.

To review or change this setting:
